summary: Completed comprehensive testing of salon booking application. Backend API testing achieved 82.4% success rate with critical bugs in blacklist and reservation limit features. Frontend flows work correctly for basic booking, admin login, service/worker management.

critical_bugs.issue: Blacklisted phone numbers can still create reservations
critical_bugs.impact: Security vulnerability - blocked customers can bypass restrictions
critical_bugs.details: Expected 403 Forbidden, got 200 OK when blacklisted phone attempts booking

critical_bugs.issue: Max 3 reservations per phone per day limit not enforced
critical_bugs.impact: Business rule violation - customers can exceed daily booking limits
critical_bugs.details: 4th reservation with same phone was allowed (expected 400, got 200)

minor_issues.impact: Some time slots show as available but fail when booking
minor_issues.details: Error: 'Izabrani termin više nije dostupan' during concurrent bookings

integration_issues.issue: No reservations displayed in admin dashboard
integration_issues.details: Created reservations not visible in admin panel, may be date filtering issue

accessibility_issues.details: React warnings about missing Description for DialogContent components

critical_fixes: Fix blacklist functionality in /api/reservations endpoint - blacklisted phones should return 403
Implement proper max 3 reservations per phone per day validation
Debug admin reservations display issue - created reservations not showing
investigation_needed: Check reservation date filtering in admin dashboard
Verify blacklist table structure and query logic
Review reservation limit counting logic in backend
